extraction.text:
Aditi Manna

📱 9564694882 | ✉ aditi86professional@gmail.com | 🌐 LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aditimanna | 📍 Bangalore, IN

Summary

Generative AI Engineer with 10+ years of IT experience across Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and AI-driven business solutions. Proven expertise in LLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and MLOps for building scalable enterprise AI systems. Hands-on with LangChain, Hugging Face, Snowflake, AWS, and GCP, delivering production-ready GenAI solutions that accelerate automation, knowledge discovery, and decision-making.

Core Skills

Programming: Python, SQL, PySpark

Generative AI: LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph

MLOps & Data: SageMaker, Vertex AI, dbt, Airflow, Databricks, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Terraform)

Vector DBs: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate

ML/NLP: Hugging Face, PyTorch, SpaCy, NLTK, Transformers

Clouds: AWS (Glue, Redshift, EMR, Lambda), GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer)

Monitoring: LangSmith, Prometheus, Grafana

Professional Experience

Senior Engineering Lead | Persistent Systems | Oct 2022 – Present | Bangalore



Led LLM adoption initiatives, building RAG-powered knowledge assistants for enterprise clients.

Migrated legacy ETL workflows into AI-enhanced pipelines integrating LangChain + dbt.

Designed real-time streaming analytics using Kafka + LLM summarizers.

Mentored engineering teams in GenAI, prompt design, and MLOps best practices.

Senior Data Scientist | Collabera @ Deloitte | Nov 2020 – Sep 2022 | Bangalore

Built a customer intelligence platform with predictive ML/NLP at scale for 8M+ users.

Applied domain-specific LLM fine-tuning for client documentation search.

Automated ML lifecycle with Vertex AI pipelines.

Staff Software Engineer | Altimetric @ Twitter | Nov 2018 – Nov 2019 | Bangalore

Designed & deployed ML/NLP solutions for social media analytics (trending topics, sentiment, bot detection).

Introduced transformer-based models for classification & moderation.

Earlier Roles | Foray, Maps IT, Tuli eServices, NCR Techno | 2013 – 2017

Developed web/mobile applications and early ML models for BFSI and healthcare clients.

Selected Projects (Mix of Data + GenAI)

1. Modern Data Stack Migration to Snowflake (AWS + dbt + Airflow)

Migrated 100+ legacy SQL scripts to dbt models using incremental materializations.

Automated dbt + Airflow deployment via GitHub Actions + Docker.

Improved query performance by 40% and reduced infra cost by 25%.

2. ETL & ML Pipeline for a Content Management & Insurance Client

Built data pipeline with AWS Data Pipeline + EMR + S3.

Developed a recommendation system using Scikit-learn & PyTorch.

Deployed ML models on AWS SageMaker with Lambda & API Gateway.

3. Enterprise Knowledge Assistant (RAG + Fine-Tuning)



Built RAG pipeline with LangChain + FAISS; fine-tuned LLaMA-2 with LoRA.

Deployed on AWS SageMaker with <1s latency, reducing document lookup time by 70%.

4. GenAI-powered Data Pipeline Optimizer

Developed SQL assistant using GPT-4 + LangChain SQLToolkit integrated with dbt & Airflow.

Improved pipeline debugging speed by 60% and cut compute costs by 25%.

5. Customer Support Chatbot with LLM Fine-Tuning

Fine-tuned Mistral-7B on support logs; integrated chatbot with CRM.

Reduced ticket resolution time by 40% and boosted CSAT by 25%.

Education

B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering | WBUT, Kolkata | 2009
